tool.name: gsva
tool.version_command: echo $(R --version | grep version | grep -v GNU)", GSVA version" $(R --vanilla --slave -e "library(GSVA); cat(sessionInfo()\$otherPkgs\$GSVA\$Version)" 2> /dev/null | grep -v -i "WARNING: ")", optparse version" $(R --vanilla --slave -e "library(optparse); cat(sessionInfo()\$otherPkgs\$optparse\$Version)" 2> /dev/null | grep -v -i "WARNING: ")

param.name: expression_file
param.label: Expression Data
param.help: A tabular file containing gene expression data (genes as rows, samples as columns)

param.name: gene_sets_file
param.label: Gene Sets
param.help: A GMT file containing gene sets

param.name: tau
param.label: Exponent for weighting the random walk

param.name: max_diff
param.label: Calculate enrichment score as difference between positive and negative random walk deviations
param.help: If unchecked, calculates as maximum deviation from zero. Default: True

param.name: alpha
param.label: Exponent for weighting the tail in the random walk

param.name: normalize
param.label: Normalize scores by the absolute difference between min and max

tool.help:
GSVA_ is a Bioconductor package for Gene Set Variation Analysis. It estimates the variation of gene set enrichment over the samples in an expression dataset.
-----
**Inputs**
**Expression Data**
A tabular file containing gene expression data. Genes should be in rows and samples in columns. The first column should contain gene identifiers, and subsequent columns should contain expression values for each sample.
Example:
========= ============ ============ GeneID Sample1 Sample2 ========= ============ ============ GeneA 10.5 12.3 GeneB 8.2 9.1 GeneC 15.1 14.7 ========= ============ ============
**Gene Sets**
A GMT file containing gene sets. In GMT format, each row represents a gene set, with the set name in the first column, a description in the second, then the identifiers of the genes in the set in the following columns.
Example:
================== ================================================================== ====== ===== ==== HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS http://www.broadinstitute.org/gsea/msigdb/cards/HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS CASP3 CASP9 ... HALLMARK_HYPOXIA http://www.broadinstitute.org/gsea/msigdb/cards/HALLMARK_HYPOXIA PGK1 PDK1 ... ================== ================================================================== ====== ===== ====
-----
**Outputs**
* **GSVA Scores**: A tabular file of GSVA enrichment scores, with gene sets in rows and samples in columns.
